models_evaluated: SCM Navigator (LLM-based, EHR-integrated surgical comanagement triage tool)

links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of LLM surgical comanagement triage tool in prospective deployment, with physician review as reference
links.effect: Sensitivity 0.94 (95% CI 0.91-0.96), specificity 0.74 (95% CI 0.71-0.77); LLM misclassification accounted for 2 of 19 false-negative cases (11%).
links.quote: Using treating physicians' determinations as the reference standard, the tool had high sensitivity (0.94; 95% CI, 0.91-0.96) and moderate specificity (0.74; 95% CI, 0.71-0.77) for identifying patients appropriate for SCM.

unlisted_practices: LLM-based triage of surgical patients for hospitalist comanagement eligibility
Thematic analysis of physician free-text disagreement feedback to refine clinical criteria and workflow
Manual chart review of all false-negative cases to attribute errors to LLM versus criteria or workflow

screen.reason: Prospective quality improvement study evaluating the real-world deployment of an EHR-integrated, LLM-based surgical comanagement triage tool with human-in-the-loop clinician review.
